issues.summary: Pacific Star Shipping refused to issue the D/O for MBL PSSU260555 / HBL MFCIM260015 (container PSSU2398736) because no telex release had been received from origin, delaying cargo release by about 2 days.
The premature D/O request before telex release confirmation resulted in 2 days of demurrage on container PSSU2398736 costing USD 560.

decisions.summary: Meridian absorbs the USD 560 demurrage on HBL MFCIM260015 as a Meridian error and does not bill it to Daehan Precision.
The team is to be re-trained on SOP-02 section 2.4 with a reminder circulated to all import handlers to confirm release status before requesting a D/O.

tasks.summary: Re-train the team on SOP-02 section 2.4 and circulate a reminder to everyone handling imports.
Forward the carrier's telex release confirmation for MBL PSSU260555 to Jiwoo Han once received.
